plans.note: Separate IBM and Customer liability caps in 9.1 and 9.2 — check cap amount/mutuality, consequential damages exclusion and carve-outs (indemnity, confidentiality, IP, payment). Sec 5.4 may add further disclaimers that operate as de facto liability limits.

8.1 is IBM's indemnity (test IP infringement scope, defence/settlement, remedies); 8.2 is our indemnity (test breadth). Sec-1 appears to be the indemnification procedure sub-list (notice, control of defence). Check whether indemnity is carved out of the 9.1/9.2 caps.

No non-compete heading; 14.16 'Freedom of Action' typically preserves IBM's freedom rather than restricting us. Confirm 14.16 and 14.11 (No Resale) impose no restraint on our business or on building/buying competing services before concluding absent.
Look for any sole-source/exclusive-provider language in the services description (13.1), charges (4.1) or Freedom of Action (14.16); IBM base terms usually contain none.
Check pricing (4.1) and amendments (13.3) for any best-price/most-favoured-customer undertaking running against us; likely no MFN either way.
14.8 'Personnel' is the likely home of any hiring/solicitation restriction — check whether it binds Customer, its duration, and whether general advertising and unsolicited applicants are carved out.
3.4 is the core clause: check notice period, whether the right is mutual or IBM-only, and any termination charge/unamortised-cost penalty cross-referenced in 3.5 or 4.1.
3.2 Renewal — test for automatic renewal, length of renewal term, the non-renewal notice window and any uplift/repricing mechanic; read with the initial term in 3.1.

14.3 Choice of Law (New York is common in IBM forms — accepted). Also check 14.4 jury waiver, 14.14 Actions Period (contractual limitation period shortening our claims) and 14.19 geographic scope for any forum limitation.

14.10 Assignment — check whether we may assign to affiliates/successors without consent, whether IBM consent is unreasonably withheld, and whether change of control gives IBM a termination or consent right.

12.1 License and 14.17 Limitation of Licenses govern IP ownership/reservation; 11.6 Content and Digital Certificates and 14.18 Data Protection should confirm our ownership of Customer content/data. 14.6 covers trademark use — ensure no grant of our marks beyond limited publicity.
12.1 is the grant — test scope (affiliates, contractors/users), revocability, term-coextensiveness and territorial limits; 14.17 and 14.11 (No Resale) will contain the express restrictions.

11.3 Suspected Violations is the likely audit/inspection or investigation right against us; read with 13.2 AUP and 11.5 Capacity Planning. Check notice, frequency, on-site access, suspension rights and who bears cost.
Check 4.2 for late-payment interest/penalty and 4.1/3.5 for early-termination or shortfall charges payable by us; confirm any service-credit regime runs in our favour only.

5.1 is IBM's warranty set; 5.2/5.4 disclaim everything else (check for 'AS IS' and no-uninterrupted-service language). 11.1 Services Support and 12.2 Maintenance of Base Components carry the practical remedy; 11.2 contains our reciprocal warranties.

No insurance heading in the outline; 5.3 Security and 14.12 Risk of Loss are the nearest analogues. Treat as missing unless an insurance covenant is buried in those sections or in an Order Form/Service Option Attachment.

Check 4.1 Charges for committed volumes/minimum monthly fees and 11.5 Capacity Planning for committed capacity; confirm any commitment has an exit via 3.4 termination for convenience without shortfall payment.

3.5 Effect of Termination is the primary location — test for data return/extraction in a usable format, a retrieval window, continuation of services during migration and any fees; 14.18 and 11.6 may bear on content handling, 14.2 on survival.
